description: An unknown choice between two strings is not equal to null
notes: The spec says a comparison with an unknown operand gives an unknown bool. For results that aren't numbers or collections of one type, ConditionalExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) still refines the unknown result as not null when neither result can be null, and Value.Equals (cty/value_ops.go) uses that to rule out null.
